title: One Password, Many Doors
description:
A fictional authentication log shows a coordinated attempt against a lab service:

```
02:01:11 LOGIN FAIL user=alice   src=198.51.100.23 attempts=1
02:01:14 LOGIN FAIL user=bob     src=198.51.100.23 attempts=1
02:01:18 LOGIN FAIL user=carol   src=198.51.100.23 attempts=1
02:01:21 LOGIN FAIL user=dave    src=198.51.100.23 attempts=1
02:02:02 LOGIN OK   user=svc_backup src=198.51.100.23
```

Many usernames were tried with a small set of common passwords from one source.
objective: Identify the technique (two words, underscore-separated) and submit HC{technique}.

hints.text: Unlike brute force, this technique spreads a few passwords across many accounts.
